mapper.select: SELECT t.tx_id, t.tank_id, tk.tank_name, tk.fuel_type, t.liter, t.unit_price, t.total_amount, t.payment_type, t.input_type, t.approval_no, t.tx_datetime, t.created_at FROM tb_transaction t JOIN tb_tank tk ON t.tank_id = tk.tank_id WHERE t.tx_datetime BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY t.tx_datetime ASC, t.tx_id ASC

SELECT t.tx_id, t.tank_id, tk.tank_name, tk.fuel_type, t.liter, t.unit_price, t.total_amount, t.payment_type, t.input_type, t.approval_no, t.tx_datetime, t.created_at FROM tb_transaction t JOIN tb_tank tk ON t.tank_id = tk.tank_id WHERE t.tx_datetime >= #{since} ORDER BY t.tx_datetime ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_transaction (tank_id, liter, unit_price, total_amount, payment_type, input_type, approval_no, tx_datetime, created_at) VALUES (#{tankId}, #{liter}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentType}, #{inputType}, #{approvalNo}, #{txDatetime}, NOW())

INSERT INTO tb_transaction (tank_id, liter, unit_price, total_amount, payment_type, input_type, approval_no, tx_datetime, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.tankId}, #{item.liter}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.totalAmount}, #{item.paymentType}, #{item.inputType}, #{item.approvalNo}, #{item.txDatetime}, NOW())
